verdict.rationale: Core request-time functionality (model routing, fallbacks, caching, BYOK, embeddings, model listing) is fully API-driven and even has an unauthenticated public models endpoint, showing strong API parity for usage. However, management-plane features like budgets, spend caps, and detailed usage/log dashboards are described only as UI pages (Requests/Usage sections, CSV/JSON export) with no documented API for configuring or querying them programmatically.
